description.value: At 1st level, the engineer receives the Limit Breaks (Auto-Repair and Overdrive). Auto-Repair (Su): This Limit Break grants the engineer an aura that extends out to 30 feet around him. Any damaged items or machinery chosen by the engineer within the area of effect start repairing themselves at 4 hit points + an additional 4 hit points per four engineer levels after 1st for a duration of 1 round + 1 round per four engineer levels after 1st. This limit break requires only a swift action. Overdrive (Su): This Limit Break increases the overall combat effectiveness of the engineer's automaton. For the duration of 1 round + 1 round per four engineer levels after 1st, the automaton gains a 2/- DR and +2 enhancement bonus to Strength and Dexterity. These bonuses increase by said amount per four engineer levels after 1st. This limit break requires only a swift action.
